text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 582 College Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for the proposed boulevard café located at 582 College Street, with the following condition: a. Windows and doors fronting onto College Street must remain closed at all times, live music or DJ music is played inside the establishment.
